description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): read one tenant's mesh policy (GET /api/v1/connect/policies/:id) as connect.policy@1, with its grants, default action, exit-node setting and subnet routes. A policy is readable only inside its own tenant; the answer carries no pre-auth key, WireGuard key or control-plane ACL file.
